verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Internal Agent is driven by natural-language prompts. Users describe the flows, policies, knowledge and tool connections they want and the agent configures them. Users also prompt it to run test scenarios and to produce performance and gap reports, and guardrails and routing rules are written as plain-language instructions. Natural-language-driven actions are gated by approvals and published as revertable releases. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as documented.
